links.note: Health is the ultimate wealth is Dr Poshita's line, which 32678 restates as its conclusion: a balanced diet plus avoiding junk food makes a healthy body.
Packaged chips and sugary drinks with obesity in the long run is the junk-food case of 32678; 32677 would be the answer if the item asked what a balanced diet is rather than what junk food costs.
Symptom, then deficiency, then dietary change across a whole community is exactly the survey method Activity 3.4 sets out in 32672.
